readerNotes.line: Western tip of the bulge reaches about 4.97E 50.18N near the army group boundary. North end where the heavy line comes down near the Maas at about 5.84E; the Westwall hatching near Aachen was not used. The south east end leaves the east edge near Saarlautern; a heavy line running south from there toward Metz looks like a boundary and was not followed. Line thinned to 38 points.
